details: @dforge-core/dforge-mcp is a legitimate MCP server for dForge module authoring. On 2026-09-09 an attacker with access to the maintainer account changed the repository so that pushes to main trigger the release workflow, and published version 0.2.21 carrying the GHAPPIER remote code loader on a single line (line 3320) of a 99 KB configuration file. The loader runs when the MCP server is started, not at install time, and opens a four-stage chain whose final implant deletes itself from disk. 0.2.21 was published at 2026-09-09T17:19:50Z and was the latest release for about 36 minutes, until the maintainer published a clean 0.2.22 at 17:55:28Z; 0.2.21 has since been removed from npm. Other versions are not affected. Documented by CloudSEK (2026-09-20).
